stories.title: Flintshire Council left with “very little room” as emergency fund shrinks to £766,000
stories.summary: Flintshire Council’s emergency fund is forecast to fall to £766,000 by the end of March as the authority heads for a £7.6m overspend. stories.title: Flintshire petrol average falls 4.6p in a week but no forecourt near RAC’s 150p forecast
stories.summary: Drivers in Flintshire are paying up to 14p a litre more for petrol depending on which forecourt they use, Deeside.com’s fuel tracker shows. Asda Queensferry was selling unleaded at 159.7p a litre on Tuesday morning. Two other Asda forecourts in the county, Asda Singing Kettle and Asda Wylfa in Mold, were charging 172.9p and 171.9p.

stories.title: Man wanted since 2023 over Chester drugs investigation arrested in Thailand

stories.title: Young people claiming out-of-work benefits in Flintshire up 24% in a year
stories.summary: The number of young people claiming out-of-work benefits in Flintshire has risen by almost a quarter in a year. stories.title: Two Buckley roads shut following road traffic collision
stories.summary: Springfield Road and Well Street in Buckley are closed following a road traffic collision. North Wales Police’s South Flintshire team posted an alert on Tuesday morning saying both roads were shut. Officers are asking drivers to avoid the area. The team said: There is currently a road closure on Springfield Road and Well Street, Buckley
